Upgrade your Ride & Unlock 10+ miles with our Adventure Package - a ride through the Trout, St. Johns & Arlington Rivers, EverBank Stadium, and the Downtown Riverbanks. Spot dolphins, speed through open water, and film breathtaking moments from every angle! Only at Jax Water Adventures.
